OpenGL ICD DEPLOYMENT — WHICH FILES MUST GO WHERE (and why)
=============================================================
(Learned the hard way on 192.168.1.143, 2026-07-20: a week of "the fix
didn't work" was actually stale per-game DLL copies.)

The display driver pair (3dfxv5m.sys / 3dfxv5d.dll) installs once via
SetupAPI (INSTALL.bat / updrv.exe) and is machine-global. The OpenGL ICD
(3dfxogl.dll) is NOT global in practice: games load their own app-local
copy first. Deploying a new ICD build means updating EVERY copy below —
miss one and that game silently keeps the old driver.

WINDOWS DLL SEARCH ORDER IS THE TRAP
------------------------------------
LoadLibrary("opengl32") / LoadLibrary("<r_glDriver>") checks the game's
own directory BEFORE system32. Games on the fleet that carry a local GL
DLL (inventory a box with:  dir /s /b C:\opengl32.dll C:\3dfxogl.dll):

  Quake III Arena\Quake3\opengl32.dll     <- r_glDriver "opengl32" loads THIS
  Quake III Arena\Quake3\3dfxogl.dll      <- loaded if r_glDriver "3dfxogl"
  <each CS/Half-Life install>\opengl32.dll  (BC Romania AND the plain
                                             Counter-strike dir — BOTH)
  Games\Quake2\opengl32.dll (+3dfxogl.dll)
  GOG Games\Unreal Tournament GOTY\System\opengl32.dll
  WINDOWS\system32\3dfxogl.dll            <- registry ICD entry target

NEVER touch WINDOWS\system32\opengl32.dll or dllcache\opengl32.dll —
that is Microsoft's dispatcher, WFP-protected, and not ours.

DEPLOY PROCEDURE (new ICD build)
--------------------------------
1. Kill every running GL game first (a loaded DLL is locked and copy
   fails SILENTLY in a batch loop — check every copy's output):
     taskkill /f /im quake3.exe & taskkill /f /im hl.exe  (etc.)
2. Stage once:  UPLOAD -> C:\RETRO_AGENT\3dfx-driver\3dfxogl-stage.dll
3. copy /Y the stage file over EVERY path in the inventory above
   (keep a .preNNN backup of each on first replacement).
4. Verify each target's size/date changed (dir per file). Version check:
   the renderer string "3Dfx [retro3dfx X.Y.Z]" — gltest/gfix logs it,
   or any GL game's console (Q3: /gl_renderer).
5. Never launch a second fullscreen GL game while one is running — a
   fullscreen Glide surface collision can wedge the whole box for
   minutes (or require power-cycle).

WHY BOTH NAMES IN THE Q3 DIR: q3config.cfg r_glDriver decides which
filename Q3 loads. Fleet boxes have shipped with both "opengl32" and
"3dfxogl" configured at different times — keep the two files identical.

GLIDE STACK: glide3x.dll also lives BOTH in system32 and next to some
game exes (Q3 dir). Same rule: update all copies together.

HISTORY (why versions matter)
-----------------------------
  0.2.2  UT glTexSubImage2D NULL-cache crash fix
  0.3.1  Napalm 16-byte texture-heap alignment — fixed the notorious
         "sliced/garbled 2D text" in Q3 menus + CS VGUI (texBaseAddr
         drops addr bits [3:0] on VSA-100; heap started at min+8)
  0.3.2  EXT_paletted_texture RGBA table stride — fixed GoldSrc world
         textures rendering green/blue (palette read as 3-byte RGB)
  0.3.3  GoldSrc fps 3x: reuse the Glide context across MakeCurrent
         switches (was full WinClose+WinOpen each); all PFDs
         double-buffered (CS ~33 -> ~100 fps)
  0.3.4d CS green world: stale 2PPC (combineMode bit-29) cleared by a
         full TMU1 state re-issue at SwapBuffers
  0.3.5  gate that hook on REAL dual-texture frames (__r3d_sawTMU0) —
         0.3.4d fired in Q3 too and broke menu colors
  0.3.6  ** ICD NEVER OPENED >640x480 until here ** — the res walk used
         a Voodoo1/2-era cap table; V3/V5 hardware strings fell through
         to "Voodoo1 2MB" = clamp to 640x480 (black world at 800/1024
         on the monitor). Modern boards now bypass the cap gate.
  0.3.7  drop the 0.3.5 combine-cache invalidation (it re-broke CS).
         SHIP BUILD, verified on .143 V5 5500: CS de_dust 0-green,
         Q3 640/800/1024 = 72.8/73.0/71.7 fps at REAL resolutions,
         Q2 135+, UT + RTCW render. md5 ee69a4b9c2e5fe535d27929544a6045e

V5-SPECIFIC CAVEATS (as of 2026-07-21)
--------------------------------------
- 3DMark2001/D3D: the D3D HAL path can HARD-FREEZE a V5 box (no ping,
  physical reboot) — suspect Napalm-only compressed-texture (DXT/FXT1)
  path and/or 2-chip SLI FIFO; under investigation. Do NOT run 3DMark
  with Texture Format=Compressed on a V5 until cleared. OpenGL games
  are unaffected.
- Deploy display+miniport under WFP-safe names (3dfxv5d.dll/3dfxv5m.sys,
  voodoo5-wfp.inf) — standard names get silently reverted by WFP.
- fbdump capture (C:\icd_fbdump.on) is the only truthful screenshot of
  fullscreen GL; GDI SCREENSHOT garbles (that garble is NORMAL and means
  the hw path is active).
